# cross_arch_common_dep_two_archs

Pins the cross-arch ``MetaTemplate`` emission path
(``template_graph.cowalk.cross_arch``) → phase-4 planner
(``plan_meta._process_cross_arch``). When a dep is present at the
same ``(role, enforce)`` position in every covered arch AND shares
its ``(hash, name)`` across them (class D in the A/B/C/D classifier),
``plan_phase4_for_binary`` MUST emit exactly one
``build_common_dep__cross_arch__<ident>`` descriptor (rather than one
per-arch ``build_common_dep`` duplicate) and wire it into every
covered variant's ``depends_on``.

Without the meta post-pass (and the role-merge keymap behind it),
the per-cell walker would emit one ``build_common_dep`` per arch with
distinct task_ids — even though the underlying ident is the same.
Cross-binary dedup at ``plan_phase4_from_graph`` would collapse those
on ``task_id`` only after the fact; the meta path lets the framework
deduplicate up-front and assign the meta entry a positive
``priority_hint`` so the most-shared artefacts run ahead of per-arch
variants (see ``plan_meta._META_COMMON_DEP_PRIORITY_HINT``).

**Tree**: 1 binary ``hello`` × 2 archs (x86_64 + aarch64) × 1 variant
per arch (gcc15-O2 baseline). Each variant has a single
``glibc-2.40.drv`` child. The two arch variant roots have distinct
hashes (their drv path embeds the arch), but the glibc child has the
SAME ident on both sides — the post-collapse role
(``glibc.drv``) matches across archs, so the MetaTemplate classifier
returns class D for that position.

Note on the "different hash per arch" framing in the brief: a true
cross-compiled glibc would produce arch-specific drvs (class A). For
the cross_arch descriptor to be emitted the ident MUST be shared
(class D). This fixture pins the class-D path because that is the
ONLY classification ``plan_meta._process_cross_arch`` mints a
descriptor for; class-A leaves the per-cell ``build_common_dep``
emissions in place. Both behaviours are exercised in
``test_streaming/test_meta_templates.py`` already; this fixture pins
the descriptor-emission half (planner side, not graph side).

**Expected**:
  - ``build_variant_count == 2`` — both variants land in the
    descriptor list (one per arch).
  - ``common_deps_cross_arch_min >= 1`` — at least one
    ``build_common_dep__cross_arch__*`` descriptor present.
  - ``per_variant_toolchain_task`` — explicit ``null`` per label
    documents that without phase-1 emitted ``build_compilers__*``
    task_ids (the fixture's ``toolchain_task_ids`` is empty),
    ``_variant_toolchain_dep`` returns ``None`` and no toolchain
    is wired. The harness reads these as "no required toolchain
    task_id"; substitute concrete task_ids when threading a non-
    empty ``toolchain_task_ids`` through this fixture.

**variant_lookup.json convention**: list-of-records,
``[{"key": [arch, label], "value": {...}}, ...]``.

**tree.txt provenance**: generated by
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.fixtures.render_tree`` with
deterministic ``make_hash`` seeds (0/1/2 for root/toolchain/matrix,
10/30 for the two variant roots, 700 for the shared glibc child).
